name: repository-manager
description: Coordinate branches and Git workflows across a parent repository and its linked repositories from one VS Code dashboard

commands.title: Align Linked Repositories with Recorded Commits

repositoryManager.defaultBranch.description: Default branch name for new branches

repositoryManager.autoFetch.description: Fetch all repositories in the background while the dashboard is visible, so ahead/behind counts stay current. Background fetches never prune deleted remote branches (the Fetch button does) and turn off credential prompts (Git's terminal prompt and askpass, SSH askpass, Git Credential Manager); a repository that needs credentials is skipped.

repositoryManager.autoFetchInterval.description: Minutes between background fetches when repositoryManager.autoFetch is enabled.

repositoryManager.liveChanges.description: Keep local changes current while you edit: saving, creating or deleting files (and staging with Git) refreshes the dashboard's uncommitted changes and change counts about a second later. Turn off in very large repositories where git status is slow; Refresh still updates them.

enumDescriptions: Send code to the selected Copilot model without asking.
Ask the first time in each repository; "Always allow for this repository" stops asking there, until "Repository Manager: Forget Review Permissions".
Ask before every request that sends code to Copilot.
repositoryManager.copilot.askBeforeSendi.markdownDescription: When to ask before code is sent to the selected Copilot model: reviews, auto-fixes, explanations of findings, summaries and commit messages. Also in the dashboard's ⚙ menu next to **Model**. VS Code itself may ask once whether Repository Manager may use language models.

repositoryManager.review.confirmBeforeSe.description: Ask before every request that sends code to Copilot.
repositoryManager.review.confirmBeforeSe.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#repositoryManager.copilot.askBeforeSending#` instead. While that setting is not set, `true` here still means **Ask every time**.

repositoryManager.githubToken.description: GitHub personal access token for PR operations
